correctness.rationale: Direct reconstruction from the multiplication uv=vu=z forces N(z)=az and reduces the remaining Nijenhuis equations to K^T J K=0. The full automorphism group is obtained from the annihilator Cz and the conformal isometry group of the hyperbolic form J. The explicit conjugation formula proves the three K=0 orbits, the two nonzero-K geometric types, and the zero/nonzero residual covector flag. Trace, kernel isotropy, rank, and the quotient class of the covector separate every displayed family. The packaged symbolic checker independently replays the defining equations and all normal forms.

value.rationale: The source itself identifies automorphism-orbit reduction as the natural next step after its complete raw operator tables. For C3 the quotient is structurally nontrivial: an isotropic rank-one matrix problem separates two geometric K-types, and a residual covector quotient contributes an additional flag. The theorem replaces five overlapping coordinate families by a complete nonredundant moduli description with explicit intrinsic invariants.
